_comment: Device check for the W3 birth readings: job b's T_7..T_14 ran on an RTX PRO 5000 (Blackwell) while T_15 and T_0..T_6 ran on an L40S, and the W1-W3 checker measured probe-activation differences between the two (median 0.56%, p99 5.2%, max 63%). This re-harvests t14_step1000000 exactly as job b did (same step, infra/aws_pg/steps/neurons_w3_grid_c_t14.json, positions from job a's T_15 positions.npz by S3 URI) and MUST run on an L40S: gpu_query pins gpu_name=L40S (vastai query syntax; controller.py appends disk_space>=120 and, in download mode, inet_down>=800). On 2026-10-21 no L40S offer passed the controller's base filters (all unverified, transfer costs above 0.0001, two below reliability 0.98); the AWS fallback is g6e.2xlarge (L40S). The mirrored steps.json needs only the S3 rewrite results/neurons/ -> results/mdl/neurons/ (no local path), and job a's T_15 positions.npz must exist under results/mdl/neurons/w3/grid/1/out/t15_step1413814/poles/. Expected about 1.9 h on an L40S (job a measured 15.5 GPU-h for 8 checkpoints); max_billed_h 3.5. pg_git_sha names 17057bd0, which holds the shipped code; since then only manifests, steps files and budget.json changed under infra/.
